name: SIA 852 起落架问题 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: your call sign is SIA 852, at Wuhan airport, stand 7, you have received information M, request clearance to SIA.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 SIA 852，位于武汉机场 7 号停机位，已收到 M 情报，请求前往 SIA 的放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 852, Stand seven, information M, request clearance to SIA.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 852，7 号停机位，M 情报，请求前往 SIA 的放行许可。

cards.audioText: SIA 852, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to SIA via flight planned route, follow Z Foxtrot03D, initial climb to 1,800 meters, cruising level at 10,400 meters, Runway 18L, departure frequency 124.7, squawk 4615.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 852，武汉放行，许可按飞行计划航路飞往 SIA，执行 ZF-03D 离场，初始爬升至 1,800 米，巡航高度 10,400 米，Runway 18L，离场频率 124.7，应答机 4615。
cards.referenceText: cleared to SIA via flight planned route, follow ZF-03 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 1400 meters, Runway 18L, after departure, contact 124.7, squawk 4615, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往 SIA，执行 ZF-03 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 1400 米，Runway 18L，离场后联系 124.7，应答机 4615，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, push back and start up at your own discretion.
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up at our own discretion, SIA 852.

cards.audioText: you have completed pushback and startup procedures, you decided to make an intersection departure from E2, contact Ground to request intersection departure from E2.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已完成推出和开车程序，决定从 E2 交叉口离场，联系地面请求从 E2 交叉口离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, request intersection departure from E two.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，请求从 E2 交叉口离场。

cards.audioText: SIA 852, Intersection departure from E2 is approved. Taxi to E2 via A6, A, A2, hold short of Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 852，批准从 E2 交叉口离场。经 A6、A、A2 滑行至 E2，在 Runway 18L 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Intersection departure from E two is approved. Taxi to E two via A six, A, A two, hold short of Runway 18L, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准从 E2 交叉口离场。经 A6、A、A2 滑行至 E2，在 Runway 18L 前等待，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: During taxiing you find a vehicle broken down on taxiway A, you have stopped the aircraft, inform ATC about the situation and request airport services to tow away the vehicle.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行期间，你发现一辆车在 A 滑行道上故障，你已停止飞机，通知 ATC 情况，并请求机场服务将车辆拖走。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, a vehicle has broken down on taxiway A, we have to stop our aircraft and request airport service to tow the vehicle away.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，一辆车在 A 滑行道上故障，我们必须停止飞机，请求机场服务将车辆拖走。

cards.audioText: SIA 852, hold at present position, the ramp services will be there in a few minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 852，在当前位置等待，机坪保障人员将在几分钟后到达。
cards.referenceText: hold at present position, roger, SIA 852.

cards.audioText: Now you are holding short of Runway 18L on E2, request departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你在 E2 上的 Runway 18L 前等待，请求离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 852, holding short of Runway 18L on E two, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 852，在 E2 上的 Runway 18L 前等待，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: B: During the takeoff role, your nose will run over a sharp object on the runway surface and the nose wheel tire burst, you aborted the takeoff, notify Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：起飞滑跑期间，你的前轮压过跑道表面的尖锐物，前轮轮胎爆胎，你中断起飞，通知武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 852, our nose wheel has run over a sharp object on the runway, the tire got burst, we aborted takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 852，我们的前轮压过跑道上的尖锐物，轮胎爆胎，我们中断起飞。

cards.audioText: B: Inform ATC about the situation and request fire trucks and maintenance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：通知 ATC 情况，并请求消防车和维修。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, we have run over a sharp object, and our nose wheel tire got burst, request fire service and maintenance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，我们压过尖锐物，前轮轮胎爆胎，请求消防和维修。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 852, do you need anything else?
B: Tell ATC that you require a tug to tow your aircraft back to the apron after the inspection.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： SIA 852，你还需要其他帮助吗？
B： 告诉 ATC，你需要一辆牵引车在检查后将航空器拖回机坪。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 852, request a tug to tow us back to the apron.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 852，请求一辆牵引车将我们拖回机坪。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, tug is on the way.
B: Request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: B：请求客梯和摆渡车在停机坪准备好。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，请求客梯和摆渡车在停机坪准备好。
